title: Welcome to EntryPoint
subtitle: This first-run wizard sets up a minimal working configuration. Every step is skippable — skipping writes the defaults, which behaves exactly like previous versions.
welcome.feature1: Modular AI inference: ASR / TTS / OCR / image processing on demand
welcome.feature2: Visual pipeline editor: drag modules into workflows
welcome.feature3: Automation: directory watching, cron schedules, webhooks
language.title: Choose interface language
language.description: Takes effect immediately and is persisted with the config. You can change it later in Settings.
workspace.title: Confirm workspace directory
workspace.description: Where task workspaces live. Use a path relative to the app root or an absolute path; missing directories are created on first task.
workspace.label: Workspace directory
port.title: Confirm service port
port.description: The port for the WebUI and inference API. Default is 9800.
port.label: Port
port.restartHint: The port is restart-sensitive: changes apply after a daemon restart, then revisit via the new port.
port.invalid: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
done.title: You're all set
done.summary: The following will be written to config/app.toml:
done.importHint: Next step: head to the Modules page to import modules and download models.
footer.skipHint: Skip = use all defaults (identical to previous behavior). You can adjust everything later in Settings.
toast.skipFailed: Skip failed: could not write default config
toast.saveFailedDescription: Config was not persisted. Check the service status and retry
